To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the development of the elaboration skill during revision is related to the commitment to audience, and to the commitment to topic, which are two distinct but interrelated skills.

the use of the audience-response device in a basic writing class led to an increased extent of information and an improved holistic writing quality of the texts of the users compared to those who did not use it.

the use of an audience-response device based on the cues speakers use to elicit elaborations from their partners during conversation, facilitates the development of elaboration skills in basic writing students.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of elaboration skills in basic writing students.
the development of elaboration skills during the revision of written texts.
the development of a new approach for the instruction of basic writing students.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this study has shown that a procedure for the facilitation of elaboration during revision can be developed based on cues speakers and hearers use to elicit the elaboration of a given topic in conversation.
the development of elaboration skills during the revision process is facilitated when writers commit themselves to an imagined audience and topic.
the development of elaborative writing skills is a process in which the writer learns to make the commitment of elaborating to an absent audience and to the topic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have demonstrated that a procedure for facilitating elaboration during revision can be based on a device that provides writers with examples of the types or audience comments that prompt elaboration in natural discourse.
, first, we have shown that the device is a viable means to facilitate the development of basic writing students’ elaborative skills.

the development of elaborative revision skills is a complex process, and the facilitation of elaboration during revision requires a complex set of procedures that are based on cues used by speakers in conversation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the elaboration of ideas in writing can be supported through the implementation of a device that facilitates the revision process.
the development of elaboration skills is a gradual process, and that the ability to commit to an absent audience and to the topic at hand is an essential step on this developmental route.
the development of elaboration skills can be fostered by means of audience-response devices that facilitate elaborative revision in the context of composition instruction.
